-- Good, different constructors. Let me also check a case where the constructor might be NULL
-- or where the driver has no drive before or after the hiatus
SELECT g.year, g.driver_id, g.missed_first, g.missed_last, g.races_missed,
       (SELECT d.constructor_id FROM drives d WHERE d.year = g.year AND d.driver_id = g.driver_id 
        AND TRY_CAST(d.drive_id AS VARCHAR) != '-1' AND d.last_round < g.missed_first
        ORDER BY d.last_round DESC LIMIT 1) as prev_constructor,
       (SELECT d.constructor_id FROM drives d WHERE d.year = g.year AND d.driver_id = g.driver_id 
        AND TRY_CAST(d.drive_id AS VARCHAR) != '-1' AND d.first_round > g.missed_last
        ORDER BY d.first_round ASC LIMIT 1) as next_constructor
FROM (
  SELECT year, driver_id, first_round as missed_first, last_round as missed_last,
         (last_round - first_round + 1) as races_missed
  FROM drives
  WHERE TRY_CAST(drive_id AS VARCHAR) = '-1'
) g
WHERE g.races_missed < 3
ORDER BY g.year, g.driver_id
LIMIT 20
